caption:
DJ the Rat, our AI-animated DJ Pest Bot, busts a white-tail myth.
In one study, doctors followed 130 confirmed white-tail bites (Isbister & Gray, Med J Aust 2003).
Not one caused rotting flesh. Pain, redness and itch were usually it.
Plot twist: white-tails hunt other spiders, even redbacks.
Bite getting worse? See a doctor.
